verified_facts.text: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property to open on Sentosa, and the second Raffles address in Singapore.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property to open on Singapore's 'island in the city', and the second Raffles address in the country where Raffles was born.

verified_facts.text: The pool villas sit within tropical rainforest on a hillside beside the South China Sea on Sentosa island.
verified_facts.excerpt: cocooned within breeze-cooled tropical rainforest on the island of Sentosa, 62 sophisticated, sensorial pool villas meander down a hillside beside the South China Sea.

verified_facts.text: Each villa has separate pavilions for day and night, plus a private outdoor pool and terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover separate pavilions for day and night, while a private outdoor pool and terrace expand the living experience to encompass the lush and vibrant island landscape.

verified_facts.text: Interconnecting villas are available for families or groups of friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: For guests travelling with family or a close circle of friends, interconnecting villas offer the perfect balance of togetherness and privacy

verified_facts.text: Villa interiors are inspired by contemporary Singaporean design with touches of tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by contemporary Singaporean design with touches of tradition felt throughout the interiors

verified_facts.text: Raffles Sentosa Spa is housed in a heritage building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here, within a characterful heritage building, serenity meets vitality in a canvas of experiences

verified_facts.text: The spa offers yoga, mindfulness, massage, fitness, hydrotherapy and science-based skincare.
verified_facts.excerpt: encompassing yoga, mindfulness, massage, fitness, hydrotherapy and science-based skincare

verified_facts.text: The spa has indoor hot and cold plunge pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indoor Hot and Cold Plunge Pools

verified_facts.text: The spa has treatment rooms including a couple's suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: 12 Treatment Rooms including a couple’s suite

verified_facts.text: HAAR is a full-service salon at the resort offering therapeutic scalp treatments, cuts and styling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience elevated beauty and self-care at HAAR, our full-service salon where advanced German biotechnology meets mindful wellbeing. Offering therapeutic scalp treatments, precision cuts and refined styling.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a guided tour of Singapore in the resort's Rolls-Royce with a private guide and lunch at a heritage restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: On your personalised four-hour itinerary led by a private guide, you will explore the city's cultural landmarks and hidden neighbourhoods, with lunch at a heritage restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Naturalist-led birdwatching walks on Sentosa are run by The Untamed Paths every Saturday morning.
verified_facts.excerpt: An experience for guests of all ages – photographers, nature-lovers, families – the walk takes place every Saturday between 7.00am and 8.30am.

verified_facts.text: The birdwatching walk follows the Mount Imbiah Nature Trail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Walk the Mount Imbiah Nature Trail

verified_facts.text: Empire Grill is the resort's relaxed modern Italian signature restaurant serving classic Tuscan fare.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our relaxed modern Italian signature restaurant serves classic Tuscan fare, with dishes prepared with meticulous attention to flavour.

verified_facts.text: Royal China serves Cantonese cuisine with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dinner is at Royal China, where you will enjoy refined Cantonese cuisine in an inspiring setting with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the garden.

verified_facts.text: The resort has its own version of the Singapore Sling, the Raffles Sentosa Sling, with mixologist-led tasting sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites you to join a Raffles Sentosa Sling tasting session led by a mixologist, describing how we developed our version of the famous Singapore Sling.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a private yacht tour of Sisters' Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Today we’ll take you on a private yacht tour of Sisters’ Islands, with butler-packed canapes and a complimentary bottle of champagne for sustenance.

verified_facts.text: A Wellbeing Butler leads scent-making sessions where guests design their own fragrance to take home.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the afternoon, join a scent-making session led by our Wellbeing Butler. Select from a curated collection of luxurious oils to design a unique scent tailored to your preference.

verified_facts.text: Villa guests have an all-day butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: the butler – who is available to you all day

verified_facts.text: Private in-villa dining is offered with a bespoke menu and butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Relax and enjoy personalised private dining in the comfort and seclusion of your
villa, with a bespoke menu and attentive butler service.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fitness Centre (open 24 hours daily)
